name: Blueprint-Bench
intro: Blueprint-Bench 通过把约 20 张公寓室内照片重建为二维平面图，评估通用模型的空间智能。数据包含 50 套公寓，提交图按九项四色规则标准化，再用房间连通图、大小排序、门数量与方向的加权相似度评分。
build_method: 公寓房源照片与官方平面图, 九项四色格式规范, 确定性计算机视觉结构抽取
metric: Weighted Floor-Plan Similarity (Edge Jaccard, Degree Correlation, Density, Room/Door Counts, Door Orientation)
task_type: 多图空间重建, 平面图生成, Agent绘图
eval_feature: 模型无关输出, 确定性图结构评分, LLM/图像模型/Agent同台比较, 人类与随机基线
scale: 50套公寓, 每套约20张室内照片; 人类基线使用12套子集
task_type_en: Multi-image spatial reconstruction, floor-plan generation, agent drawing
build_method_en: Apartment-listing photos and official floor plans, nine-rule four-color format, deterministic computer-vision structure extraction
eval_feature_en: Model-agnostic output, deterministic graph scoring, shared LLM/image-model/agent comparison, human and random baselines
intro_en: Blueprint-Bench evaluates general-model spatial intelligence by reconstructing a 2D floor plan from about 20 interior apartment photographs. It contains 50 apartments; submissions follow nine four-color rules and are scored by a weighted similarity over room connectivity, size ranking, and door counts and orientations.
scale_en: 50 apartments, about 20 interior photos each; human baseline on a 12-apartment subset
metric_en: Weighted Floor-Plan Similarity (Edge Jaccard, Degree Correlation, Density, Room/Door Counts, Door Orientation)
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.25229 and the official Andon Labs evaluation page. The diagram preserves collection of 50 apartment listings with about 20 interior photos each, adaptation of official floor plans, all nine black/green/red/white rendering rules, private-majority data handling with public code and sample, separate image-model, SVG-generating LLM, and Linux-agent paths, deterministic red-center detection and flood-fill segmentation, green-door and area extraction, size-ranked room graph JSON, the six similarity components, the exact 50/20/10/10/5/5 weighting, the 12-apartment human baseline, the no-image random baseline, and public leaderboard comparison.
